afcDesc: Fire protection valves, hydrants, hoses, extinguishers, and suppression systems from American Fire Control.
afcDetail: American Fire Control delivers high-quality fire protection products trusted across critical facilities. Through S&PA, you can access AFC valves, connections, hydrants, hoses, extinguishers, and suppression systems designed for reliable life-safety performance.
afcFeature1: Certified fire protection valves and control devices
afcFeature2: Hydrants, hoses, and fire department connections
afcLineValvesDesc: OS&Y, NRS, check, butterfly, alarm check, and indicator post valves for fire networks.
afcLineHydrantsDesc: Dry barrel, wet barrel, and hydrant control solutions for outdoor fire protection.
afcLineSuppressionDesc: AFC-227, AFC-P227, AFC-5112, and kitchen fire suppression packages.
afcLineConnectionsDesc: Wall, flush, free-standing, and hydrant connection assemblies for firefighter access.
afcLineHosesDesc: Booster, LDH, rack, forestry, and jacketed fire hose options for response readiness.
afcLineExtinguishersDesc: ABC dry chemical, Halotron, CO₂, water mist, wet chemical, and wheeled units.
honeywellDesc: Building, industrial, and process automation technologies plus connected life-safety solutions from Honeywell.
honeywellDetail: Honeywell Technologies supports operations where failure is not an option — from buildings and data centers to industrial plants. S&PA partners with Honeywell to deliver automation, safety, and connected systems that improve efficiency and resilience.
honeywellFeature3: Life safety, security, and OT cybersecurity outcomes
honeywellLineBuildingsDesc: Connected building systems for comfort, efficiency, and operational visibility.
honeywellLineIndustrialDesc: Technologies that drive autonomous plant operations and workforce excellence.
honeywellLineSafetyDesc: Fire detection, life-safety, and security solutions for critical environments.
honeywellLineProcessDesc: Process control and energy innovation tools for complex industrial workflows.
spaDesc: MEP, facility, ICT, and fire-protection product solutions curated by S&PA for project delivery in Egypt.
spaDetail: S&PA selects and supplies globally recognized products aligned with our contracting and facility scopes. From electro-mechanical systems to ICT infrastructure and fire protection, our product offering supports design, supply, install, and maintain packages.
spaFeature1: MEP equipment selected for certified project delivery
spaFeature2: Facility and ICT products for critical workplaces
spaFeature3: Fire protection materials matched to approved designs
spaLineMepDesc: Mechanical, electrical, and plumbing products for complete electro-mechanical packages.
spaLineFacilityDesc: Products that support operations, maintenance, and long-term facility performance.
spaLineIctDesc: Networking, telecom, and digital infrastructure products for resilient connectivity.
spaLineFireDesc: Passive and active fire-protection products aligned with S&PA project standards.
